The USS Gerald R. Ford, commissioned by the United States, is widely reported as the most expensive aircraft carrier ever built.
The three All India Services are IAS, IPS and Indian Forest Service; the Indian Foreign Service is a Central Civil Service, not an All India Service.
The Smart Cities Mission was launched by PM Narendra Modi on 25 June 2015.
Tamil Nadu, on the east coast, receives its main rainfall from the retreating (north-east/winter) monsoon, unlike most of India which relies on the summer monsoon.
Tropical moist deciduous forest occupies the largest forested area of any type in India.
Red soil gets its colour from the presence of ferric oxides (iron oxide).
The Jayakwadi Dam, built near Paithan with Japanese assistance, is constructed on the Godavari river.
Fallow land is cultivable land that is deliberately left unsown for a season or more to let it recover fertility, so it remains 'cultivable land'.
National Waterway 1, the Allahabad-Haldia stretch via the Ganga-Bhagirathi-Hooghly river system (~1,620 km), is India's longest national waterway.
The Indira Gandhi Canal was developed as part of the Desert Development Programme, aimed at irrigating and reclaiming the arid Thar desert region of Rajasthan.
Watershed management in India is primarily aimed at soil (and water) conservation within a drainage area.
